title: Air Buns
directions: Dissolve 2 pkgs. yeast in 2 c warm water & 2 tsp. sugar.
Mix tog. as for pastry: 22 c flour, 2 tsp. salt, 1 c sugar, 1 c marg.
Make well in centre, add 6 beaten eggs; 6 c lukewarm water & yeast mixture. Knead till soft dough is formed.
Let rise once. Punch dough down & form into buns. Let rise till double.
Bake @ 400° for 20-25 min.
(Can brush c̄ melted butter when out of oven.)
notes: NB: when using quick rise yeast add to flour - heat all liquids except eggs to 125°-130° F.

title: Ever-Ready Oat-Bran Muffins
ingredients: 5 cups Robin Hood All-Purpose Flour* (1250 mL)
4 cups Robin Hood or Old Mill Oats (1000 mL)
2 cups raisins or chopped dates (500 mL)
directions: POUR boiling water over bran and let stand.
COMBINE flour, baking soda and salt in large bowl. Stir well to blend.
CREAM shortening and sugar together. Add eggs and buttermilk.
ADD liquid ingredients to flour mixture. Mix well. Add oats, raisins and bran. Stir well to blend.
FILL greased muffin cups 3/4 full. BAKE at 375° F (190° C) for 15-20 minutes or until top springs back when lightly touched.

STORAGE: Keep unused muffin batter in refrigerator until ready to use. Mixture can be kept up to 2 months. To bake, use batter directly from refrigerator and bake at 375° F (190° C) for 20-25 minutes.
notes: *or Substitute 5-2/3 cups (1400 mL) Robin Hood Cake & Pastry Flour
Preparation Time: 20 minutes  Baking Time: 20 minutes
Makes: about 5 dozen muffins
Printed Robin Hood package/box clipping

title: Prairie Biscuits
directions: Biscuit Mix: Combine all ingredients. Mix with hands until evenly blended. Store in a sealed container in a cool place. Will keep for months.

To Make Biscuits: Mix ingredients together. Blend with fork until smooth. Roll out dough until it is 1" thick. Cut biscuits with an upside down glass or cup. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.
This biscuit mix can also be used as a base for dumplings, waffles, pancakes, gingerbread, drop cookies, coffee cake, or chocolate cake.
notes: Printed Co-op clipping with intro: 'Dawn is breaking over the prairies...'
Makes 1 dozen
raw_text:
Dawn is breaking over the prairies, and though you know it's going to be a scorcher, there's still enough chill in the air to see your breath. Steamy snorts erupt from your horse's muzzle as she noses into the feedbag. Once she's been fed and watered, it's time to see what's cooking in the chuckwagon for breakfast: hotcakes and bacon for sure, and boiled coffee that would strip the shine from new leather. And if you're lucky, there's a batch of fresh hot biscuits just coming out of the cookstove - a couple of those will carry you pretty far. Maybe you can sneak a third one, if the cook's not looking...
PRAIRIE BISCUITS
BISCUIT MIX
6 cups Co-op all purpose flour
1/4 cup Magic baking powder
2/3 tablespoon cream of tartar
3/4 cup Co-op powdered skim milk
1 tablespoon salt
2/3 lb. 100% vegetable shortening
2 tablespoons sugar
Combine all ingredients. Mix with hands until evenly blended. Store in a sealed container in a cool place. Will keep for months.
TO MAKE BISCUITS
3 cups Prairie Biscuit Mix
3/4 cup water
1 cup grated cheddar cheese (optional)
Mix ingredients together. Blend with fork until smooth. Roll out dough until it is 1" thick. Cut biscuits with an upside down glass or cup. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.
This biscuit mix can also be used as a base for dumplings, waffles, pancakes, gingerbread, drop cookies, coffee cake, or chocolate cake.

title: Irish Brack (a tea bread)
directions: Soak the fruit & sugar in cold tea overnight.
Next day, preheat oven to 350°. Line loaf pan c̄ buttered paper.
Fold egg & flour into fruit mixture. Turn into loaf pan & bake for 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 hrs.
Cool & slice thinly; serve c̄ butter.

1 c brown sugar.
1 lb. mixed dried fruit
1 cup cold tea
1 egg, beaten
2 c self rising flour.
soak the fruit & sugar in cold tea overnight.
Next day, preheat oven to 350°. Line loaf pan c̄

title: Blintzes - Elegant cottage cheese pancakes
directions: To make filling: Press cheese through colander. Add salt to taste, 2 egg yolks, butter & sugar.
Make batter: by adding milk to salt & eggs, stirring in flour gradually until smooth.
Heat heavy 6" skillet & grease c̄ oil. Pour only enough batter to make a very thin pancake, tipping pan from side to side to cover the bottom. Cook on 1 side only until it blisters.
Tip onto board, c̄ cooked side up. Place rounded tbsp. of cheese mixture on pancake & fold over like an envelope.
Fry on both sides till golden brown. Serve c̄ sour cream & strawberries.

title: Mandarin Cheese Cake / Graham Wafer Pie Crust / Quiche / Easy Eggs Benedict
ingredients: 4 slices of broiled ham or back bacon
directions: === First: Mandarin Cheese Cake === Bake @ 350°.
Mix crumbs, sugar & melted butter. Press firmly into springform pan. Bake 5 min.
Beat tog. softened cream cheese, sugar & eggs. Spoon over cracker crust. Bake 30 min. Cool.
Combine sour cream & sugar. Spread over cooled cake & bake 20 min. longer. Cool.
Arrange drained orange segments all over top of cake. To make glaze, mix sugar, cornstarch & OJ together in saucepan. Heat & stir till thickened. Spread over cheese cake. Cool for 24 hrs. ac serving.
=== Second: Graham Wafer Pie Crust ===
Bake @ 350° for 8 min. Cool.
=== Third: Quiche ===
Fry bacon till crisp - Crumble & spread c̄ cheese & onion in pie plate. Whiz remain. ingred. in blender high 1 min. Pour over bacon mix.
Bake @ 350° for 45-55 min. or until golden brown & filling is set. Let stand 5 min. ac serving.
=== Fourth: Easy Eggs Benedict ===
Combine mayonnaise, sour cream, lemon juice & mustard in saucepan. Cook & stir over low heat until hot.
Split muffins & toast. Top ea. c̄ slice of meat & [egg]. Cover c̄ sauce.
